name: Motive
summary: Fleet management: ELD compliance, AI dash cams, vehicle tracking and driver safety scoring.
best_for: fleets large enough that ELD compliance and dash-cam evidence are already costing you money, and who will negotiate a quote rather than accept the first one
skip_if: you run a handful of vehicles and want to know the price before a sales call — that is not available here, and competitors in this category do publish per-vehicle rates
honest_knock: A pricing page with a form where the prices should be. That is the finding, and it matters more in fleet than in software generally. The real cost here is not a monthly rate: it is hardware per vehicle, a contract term that is usually multi-year, and an early-termination position you will not hear about until you want out. None of that is public. Before the demo call, decide your own numbers: vehicles, contract length you will accept, and what you currently pay per truck. In a quote-only category the first number you hear is anchored to what they think you can pay, not to a rate card.

pricing.notes: (2026-08-30 and 2026-10-04, read on their own pricing page) No prices are shown. gomotive.com/pricing resolves to a lead-capture form at /get-in-touch/?id=pricing — a four-step email capture before any figure appears, preceded by a geolocation prompt offering the UK site. No per-vehicle rate, no plan names with amounts, no contract length and no hardware cost is published on the pricing page, the Pro plan page or the products overview.

cost_traps.label: Quote-only pricing
cost_traps.evidence: No published price: pricing page resolves to a lead-capture form, no per-vehicle rate or plan names shown (read 30 Aug 2026)

compare_with.name: Samsara or Verizon Connect
compare_with.why: the direct fleet-platform peers — all three are quote-driven, so get three quotes for the same vehicle count and contract length rather than comparing feature lists
